description:
Execute a structured query plan and return DECRYPTED memory CONTENT (node names, summaries,
    properties; edge evidence + endpoint names) alongside structure. SAME plan schema as query_memory.
    REQUIRES a memory:read:content-scoped token — a structure-only token is rejected (403) by ENYAL.
    Account scope is enforced server-side; it cannot be set from the plan.

include_chunks.description: Also return the chunk ids behind each node. Default false.
include_chunks.title: Include Chunks

plan.description: The structured query plan (a JSON object): entity_filters [{node_type} | {name_hash}], edge_filters [{relationship, direction out|in|both}], temporal_bounds {valid_from_after, valid_to_before} (ISO 8601), limit (<= 200), include_neighbours_depth (0-5). The schema and the allowed node_type / relationship values are in this tool's description.
plan.title: Plan

name: query_memory_content
